  s23: rb = maybe.or b 0

unit same_word
  why "check whether a word matches a target text"
  takes w : text
  takes target : text
  gives bool
  s0: same = w == target
  s1: give same
end same_word

unit count_word
  why "count occurrences of a word in a list"
  takes words : seq of text
  takes target : text
  gives int
  s0: matches = seq.keep words with is_target target
  s1: count = seq.length matches
  s2: give count
end count_word

unit is_target
  why "check whether a word equals a target"
  takes w : text
  takes target : text
  gives bool
  s0: same = same_word w target
  s1: give same
end is_target

unit better_word
  why "choose the better word by count, then alphabetically"
  takes a : pair of text and int
  takes b : pair of text and int
  gives pair of text and int
  s0: a_better_count = a.second > b.second
  s1: b_better_count = b.second > a.second
  s2: better = choose_better a b a_better_count b_better_count
  s3: give better
end better_word

unit choose_better
  why "choose between two scored words"
  takes a : pair of text and int
  takes b : pair of text and int
  takes a_better_count : bool
  takes b_better_count : bool
  gives pair of text and int
  s0: better = when a_better_count then a else when b_better_count then b else alpha_better a b
  s1: give better
end choose_better

unit alpha_better
  why "break a tie alphabetically"
  takes a : pair of text and int
  takes b : pair of text and int
  gives pair of text and int
  s0: better = when a.first <= b.first then a else b
  s1: give better
end alpha_better

unit score_word
  why "pair a word with its count"
  takes words : seq of text
  takes w : text
  gives pair of text and int
  s0: n = seq.count words with same_word w
  s1: p = pair.make w n
  s2: give p
end score_word

unit pick_best
  why "fold helper for best scored word"
  takes so_far : maybe of pair of text and int
  takes item : pair of text and int
  gives maybe of pair of text and int
  s0: has_best = maybe.is_some so_far
  s1: best = when has_best then maybe.or so_far item else item
  s2: next = maybe.some best
  s3: give next
end pick_best

unit most_common_word
  why "give the most common lower-case word, breaking ties alphabetically"
  takes t : text
  gives text
  s0: words = text.split_words t
  s1: lower = seq.each words with text.lower
  s2: distinct = seq.distinct lower
  s3: scored = seq.each distinct with score_one lower
  s4: best = seq.fold scored maybe.none with pick_best
  s5: answer = when maybe.is_some best then best.first else ""
  s6: give answer
end most_common_word

unit score_one
  why "score one word against the full word list"
  takes words : seq of text
  takes w : text
  gives pair of text and int
  s0: p = score_word words w
  s1: give p
end score_one
